author: Forbes
description:
At $130,000 an hour, astronaut time is the most expensive labor off Earth. So why are highly-trained scientists spending their days doing orbital chores like unpacking cargo?

Enter Icarus Robotics: a startup determined to build the autonomous "labor force for space." Founded by two twenty-somethings with unconventional backgrounds—including a former Mercedes Formula 1 engineer—Icarus is taking a massive gamble to automate the commercial space economy. By sending AI-powered robots to handle the grueling logistical grunt work, astronauts will finally be freed up to focus on groundbreaking microgravity research that could change life back on Earth.

With a high-stakes mission to the International Space Station scheduled for 2027, watch how these young founders are ignoring traditional aerospace rules to revolutionize our future among the stars.

description:
Marcus Shaw, CEO of AltFinance, joins Forbes senior writer Jabari Young on The Enterprise Zone from the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills. Shaw discusses the mission behind AltFinance, a nonprofit, to create better pathways to careers in private investment for HBCU students.
